# Go-Gui

> Go-Gui is a GUI framework for Go. You write the UI, the state and the app in
> Go only, with no browser, JavaScript, HTML or CSS. It renders with the GPU:
> Metal on macOS, OpenGL without cgo on Linux and Windows, WebGL/WASM in the
> browser. Import path: `github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/gui`.

Go-Gui is immediate-mode. A view function runs again each frame and returns a
tree of `gui.View`. There is no virtual DOM and no diffing. App state is one
typed slot per window: `gui.State[App](w)`. This call panics when `App` is not
the type given to `WindowCfg.State`.

Rules that code for Go-Gui must obey. The code compiles when you break them, but
one behavior is wrong:

- Every widget takes a `Cfg` struct with usable zero values, for example
  `gui.Button(gui.ButtonCfg{...})`. Callbacks are `func(ctx gui.EventCtx)`.
- Nothing marks an event as handled for you. A callback that acts on an event
  calls `ctx.Consume()`.
- To focus a widget, it must be `Focusable` and have an `ID`. Input controls are
  focusable by default. To opt out, set `FocusDisabled: true`. Do not set
  `Focusable: false`.
- An empty `ID` gets a generated ID (such as `~input3`). Set an explicit `ID`
  when code names the widget (`SetFocus`, `FindByID`, `Test*`). Never write a
  `~` ID by hand.
- `SetFocus`, `FindByID` and `Test*` take the effective ID: the leaf joined with
  `:` to the IDs of its ID-bearing ancestors. Build it with `gui.ScopeID` or
  `gui.ScopeIDN`. Read it back with `w.ResolveID`.
- Build `Color`, `Padding`, `Sizing`, `Spacing`, `Radius` and `Border` with
  their constructors and roles (`gui.RGB`, `gui.Hex`, `gui.PadAll`,
  `gui.FillFill`, `gui.SpacingMedium`, `gui.RadiusMedium`, `gui.BorderThin`),
  not struct literals. `Color{}` means "not set".
- Use `Opt[T]` (`gui.Some`, `gui.SomeF`) only on fields where zero is a real
  value. Use a plain `Color` on a Cfg, not `Opt[Color]`.
- Read text styles and colors from theme roles (`gui.CurrentTheme()`,
  `w.Theme()`). Do not write font sizes or dimming alpha values at the call
  site.
- Set accessibility text with `A11YLabel` and `A11YDescription`.
- `AmendLayout` runs under the window lock. Do not call `SetFocus` or `SetView`
  from it. Use `ctx.Window.QueueCommand`.
- In `OnClick` and `OnHover`, `e.MouseX` and `e.MouseY` are local to the shape.
- Run with `GOGUI_DEBUG=1` to find duplicate IDs, focusable shapes without an
  ID, and handlers that do not consume. In tests, use `gui.NewTestWindow` and
  `w.TestFindings(mask)`.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/blob/main/README.md): what
  Go-Gui is, a minimal app, and the list of features
- [Get started example](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/blob/main/examples/get_started/main.go):
  the smallest app with state, one button and one counter
- [Developer experience cheat sheet](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/blob/main/docs/dx-cheat-sheet.md):
  the places where the obvious reading of the API is wrong (focus, IDs, `Opt`,
  events, layers, virtual lists, settings, secrets, debugging)
- [API reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/gui): every
  exported type and function in package `gui`

## Guides

- [Architecture](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/blob/main/docs/architecture.md):
  the frame pipeline, layout sizing, event dispatch and backends
- [Style guide](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/blob/main/docs/style-guide.md):
  which theme role to use for text, color and spacing
- [Typography](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/blob/main/docs/typography.md):
  the text style scale
- [Theme tokens](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/blob/main/docs/theme-tokens.md):
  the `ThemeCfg` fields, in groups
- [Adding a widget](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/blob/main/docs/cookbook-add-widget.md):
  how to write a custom widget with focus, keyboard and accessibility
- [Wiki](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/wiki): debugging, theming and
  testing guides

## Examples

- [All examples](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/tree/main/examples): one
  directory per feature, each with `main.go`, `main_test.go` and `README.md`
- [Showcase](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/tree/main/examples/showcase):
  every widget, with built-in documentation;
  [run it in the browser](https://go-gui-org.github.io/showcase/)
- [Todo](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/tree/main/examples/todo): a small
  app with list state
- [Web demo](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/tree/main/examples/web_demo):
  the WASM build

## Optional

- [Deployment](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/blob/main/docs/deployment.md):
  how to package an app for each platform
- [Profiling](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/blob/main/docs/profiling.md):
  how to measure frame time and allocations
- [Changelog](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-gui/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  changes in each release
- [go-glyph](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-glyph): the text shaping and
  rendering engine
- [go-charts](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-charts),
  [go-edit](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-edit),
  [go-term](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-term),
  [go-map](https://github.com/go-gui-org/go-map): chart, code editor, terminal
  and map widgets
